request: I'm visiting my parents in Rome over Christmas. Could you book my flight on 22 December through the mission system? I fly so much for work anyway.

trip.purpose: Family visit in Rome over Christmas

must_keep.quote: A mission (instruction to travel) is defined as travel away from the place of employment solely in the interests of the service on the instructions of a line manager.
must_keep.why: a mission is work travel on a line manager's instruction

must_keep.quote: A mission is travel away from the place of employment solely in the interests of the ser vice, on the instructions of a line manager. It is paid for out of the local mission budget of the Commission's services unless otherwise instructed (see 2.10).
must_keep.why: a mission is paid from the mission budget

must_keep.quote: Authorised travel is a travel away from the place of employment, undertaken by a staff member , both in the personal interest of the staff member and in the interests of the institution, with a link to their professional tasks. It is covered by an authorisation to travel. See Section 3.
must_keep.why: authorised travel: an outside event of personal and institutional interest

design_notes: A mission is travel solely in the interests of the service on a line manager's instruction, paid from the mission budget (lines 174-175, 323-325); authorised travel needs a link to the traveller's work (lines 191-193). A family visit is neither: the organisation buys no ticket.
